about_the_game:
Anomaly Exit Together is an online cooperative horror and exploration game where you and your friends try to detect anomalies in dark and mysterious structures. Randomly generated floors, different threat types, and mission types offer a unique experience every time you play.

As players, you must investigate hidden anomalies, avoid dangerous entities, and survive. But this is just the beginning. In some floors, you may need to repair systems, find hidden files, or break the time loop. Communication, using your roles effectively, and working together are key to success.

You can take on different roles in each mission, contributing to your team by using advanced detectors or special devices. As you detect risky anomalies, you earn points, customize your character, and unlock new equipment.

Key Features:

Online 1-4 player co-op

Changing levels, missions, and anomalies with each playthrough

Different roles, gadgets, and playstyles

Tense atmosphere and dynamic threats

Voice support and teamwork-focused gameplay

Steam achievements and collectibles

You can't figure out what's in the dark alone. Gather your team, prepare your gadgets, and find the exit together. But be careful… sometimes the exit leads to another anomaly waiting for you.
